sentences.text: Miguel es médico, y quiere vivir cerca de la iglesia.
sentences.english: Miguel is a doctor, and he wants to live near the church.

sentences.text: Hoy busca un cuarto.
sentences.english: Today he is looking for a room.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Miguel, la señora Carmen quiere alquilar un cuarto.
sentences.english: Miguel, señora Carmen wants to rent out a room.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Vive cerca del templo.
sentences.english: She lives near the church.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: ¿Está lejos del lugar donde trabajo?
sentences.english: Is it far from the place where I work?

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: No.
sentences.english: No.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Se llega caminando en un momento.
sentences.english: You get there walking in a moment.

sentences.text: Los dos caminan hacia la casa de la señora Carmen.
sentences.english: The two walk toward señora Carmen's house.

sentences.text: Es una casa pequeña, con un patio y un cerro cerca.
sentences.english: It is a small house, with a patio and a hill nearby.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Buenos días, doctor.
sentences.english: Good morning, doctor.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Pasen, pasen.
sentences.english: Come in, come in.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Buenos días, señora Carmen.
sentences.english: Good morning, señora Carmen.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Mucho gusto.
sentences.english: Pleased to meet you.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Vengo a ver el cuarto.
sentences.english: I have come to see the room.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Acá está.
sentences.english: Here it is.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Es pequeño, pero es limpio y tiene luz.
sentences.english: It is small, but it is clean and has light.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: ¿Y ahí, qué hay?
sentences.english: And there, what is there?

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Ahí hay una cama y una mesa.
sentences.english: There is a bed and a table there.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Allá, hacia el patio, está la ducha.
sentences.english: Over there, toward the patio, is the shower.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: ¿Qué tipo de cama es?
sentences.english: What kind of bed is it?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: ¿Es grande?
sentences.english: Is it big?

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Es grande y es nueva.
sentences.english: It is big and it is new.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Una parte del patio también es para usted.
sentences.english: A part of the patio is also for you.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: ¿Adónde va ese camino, al lado del patio?
sentences.english: Where does that path next to the patio go?

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Va al cerro y a la selva.
sentences.english: It goes to the hill and to the jungle.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Allá hay culebras y insectos, así que hay que tener cuidado.
sentences.english: There are snakes and insects there, so you have to be careful.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: En el mapa del pueblo, esta zona es la más bonita.
sentences.english: On the map of the village, this zone is the prettiest.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: La naturaleza está cerca.
sentences.english: Nature is close by.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: ¿Cuánto cuesta alquilar el cuarto?
sentences.english: How much does it cost to rent the room?

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: El valor es mil quinientos lempiras al mes.
sentences.english: The price is one thousand five hundred lempiras a month.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Es mucho para mí.
sentences.english: That is a lot for me.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Soy empleado de la brigada, y no soy rico.
sentences.english: I am an employee of the brigade, and I am not rich.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Yo no soy rica, doctor.
sentences.english: I am not rich, doctor.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Vivo de este cuarto y de mi granja pequeña.
sentences.english: I live from this room and from my small farm.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: ¿Una granja?
sentences.english: A farm?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Qué bueno.
sentences.english: How nice.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Siembro frijoles y cultivo tomates.
sentences.english: I sow beans and grow tomatoes.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Cavo, planto y riego.
sentences.english: I dig, plant and water.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Tengo gallinas, un cerdo y un perro.
sentences.english: I have hens, a pig and a dog.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Mi esposo era pescador, pero ya murió.
sentences.english: My husband was a fisherman, but he already died.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Lo siento mucho.
sentences.english: I am very sorry.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Señora, ¿puedo pagar la mitad ahora y la mitad a fin de mes?
sentences.english: Ma'am, can I pay half now and half at the end of the month?

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: La mitad ahora, está bien.
sentences.english: Half now is fine.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Pero no puedo bajar el valor.
sentences.english: But I cannot lower the price.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Yo alquilo este cuarto a gente buena.
sentences.english: I rent this room to good people.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Señora Carmen, el doctor ayuda a la gente pobre con la brigada.
sentences.english: Señora Carmen, the doctor helps poor people with the brigade.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Es un buen ejemplo.
sentences.english: He is a good example.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Lo sé.
sentences.english: I know.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Todos hablan bien del doctor.
sentences.english: Everybody speaks well of the doctor.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Acá al lado viven un hondureño, un guatemalteco y una familia nicaragüense.
sentences.english: Next door live a Honduran, a Guatemalan and a Nicaraguan family.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Son buenos vecinos.
sentences.english: They are good neighbors.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: ¿Y si pago mil?
sentences.english: And if I pay a thousand?

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Ni mil ni mil cien, doctor.
sentences.english: Neither a thousand nor eleven hundred, doctor.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: La cantidad es mil quinientos.
sentences.english: The amount is fifteen hundred.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Pero tengo una solución.
sentences.english: But I have a solution.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Usted paga mil cuatrocientos, y los sábados me ayuda con la granja.
sentences.english: You pay fourteen hundred, and on Saturdays you help me with the farm.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Esa es una buena solución.
sentences.english: That is a good solution.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Es una mezcla de dinero y trabajo.
sentences.english: It is a mix of money and work.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Los sábados puedo sembrar y regar.
sentences.english: On Saturdays I can sow and water.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: ¿De qué forma se paga?
sentences.english: In what form is it paid?

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: La mitad ahora, y la otra mitad a fin de mes.
sentences.english: Half now, and the other half at the end of the month.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: En mi casa hay cosas que se deben hacer.
sentences.english: In my house there are things that must be done.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: El agua se mantiene cubierta.
sentences.english: The water is kept covered.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: La jarra y la olla están acá.
sentences.english: The jug and the pot are here.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Se evita dejar basura en el patio.
sentences.english: Leaving garbage in the patio is avoided.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: La basura se pone allá, lejos de la casa.
sentences.english: The garbage is put over there, far from the house.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Eso es seguridad para todos.
sentences.english: That is safety for everyone.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Sí.
sentences.english: Yes.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Hay riesgo con las culebras y los insectos.
sentences.english: There is a risk with the snakes and the insects.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Se protege el patio con cuidado.
sentences.english: The patio is protected carefully.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Esta taza y este vaso son para usted.
sentences.english: This cup and this glass are for you.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Y esta botella es para el agua.
sentences.english: And this bottle is for the water.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: ¿Hay herramientas?
sentences.english: Are there tools?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Necesito un martillo y unos clavos para el cuarto.
sentences.english: I need a hammer and some nails for the room.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Hay un cubo y una escoba acá.
sentences.english: There is a bucket and a broom here.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: La cuerda y las herramientas están ahí, en el taller de mi hijo.
sentences.english: The rope and the tools are there, in my son's workshop.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: ¿Y el uso de la ducha?
sentences.english: And the use of the shower?

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: De seis a ocho de la mañana.
sentences.english: From six to eight in the morning.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Después, la ducha es de la familia.
sentences.english: After that, the shower is for the family.

sections.title: La historia de la señora Carmen

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Señora Carmen, ¿quién vivía antes en el cuarto?
sentences.english: Señora Carmen, who lived in the room before?

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Un joven simpático.
sentences.english: A nice young man.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Un día no me pagó por tres meses, y yo me enojé.
sentences.english: One day he did not pay me for three months, and I got angry.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Después supe la verdad: no tenía trabajo, y era pobre.
sentences.english: Then I learned the truth: he had no job, and he was poor.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Su familia vivía en un país lejano.
sentences.english: His family lived in a far-off country.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Él se arrepintió.
sentences.english: He repented.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Yo sentí compasión, porque él no merecía vivir en la calle.
sentences.english: I felt compassion, because he did not deserve to live in the street.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Lo dejé vivir otro mes.
sentences.english: I let him live another month.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Hoy es ingeniero.
sentences.english: Today he is an engineer.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Viene cada mes, me trae un regalo y me besa la mano.
sentences.english: He comes every month, brings me a gift and kisses my hand.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Mi papá fue criado de un patrón rico.
sentences.english: My dad was a servant of a rich boss.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Por eso sé lo que es ser pobre.
sentences.english: That is why I know what it is to be poor.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Todos tenemos un pecado, y una persona puede cambiar.
sentences.english: We all have a sin, and a person can change.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Esa es mi manera de ver la vida.
sentences.english: That is my way of seeing life.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Cada vez que lo veo, estoy contenta.
sentences.english: Every time I see him, I am happy.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Mi esposo decía que el que peca puede volver.
sentences.english: My husband used to say that whoever sins can come back.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Mi esposo me dio este anillo, y siempre lo llevo.
sentences.english: My husband gave me this ring, and I always wear it.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Usted tiene un corazón grande, señora.
sentences.english: You have a big heart, señora.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: ¿Y por qué dejó usted su país, doctor?
sentences.english: And why did you leave your country, doctor?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: La razón es una: quiero servir.
sentences.english: The reason is one: I want to serve.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Me dedico a la salud de los pueblos, con un ministerio de la iglesia.
sentences.english: I dedicate myself to the health of villages, with a ministry of the church.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: El líder es el pastor Andrés.
sentences.english: The leader is Pastor Andrés.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Luché mucho y logré llegar acá.
sentences.english: I fought hard and managed to get here.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: El esfuerzo fue grande.
sentences.english: The effort was great.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: ¿Adónde va uno si no tiene nada?
sentences.english: Where does one go if one has nothing?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Se va hacia donde hay ayuda.
sentences.english: One goes toward where there is help.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: No busco el éxito.
sentences.english: I am not looking for success.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Mi causa es ayudar.
sentences.english: My cause is to help.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: El resultado es ver bien a los niños.
sentences.english: The result is to see the children well.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Hay diferencias de cultura y de tradición.
sentences.english: There are differences of culture and tradition.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Pero la sociedad de este pueblo me recibió bien.
sentences.english: But the society of this village welcomed me.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: El pasado es el pasado.
sentences.english: The past is the past.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: El presente es este cuarto.
sentences.english: The present is this room.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: El futuro, Dios lo sabe.
sentences.english: The future, God knows it.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Mi patrón es el director de la brigada.
sentences.english: My boss is the director of the brigade.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Mi problema era el valor, pero ya hay solución.
sentences.english: My problem was the price, but now there is a solution.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Entonces, ¿cuándo puedo entrar al cuarto?
sentences.english: So, when can I move into the room?

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: El jueves, si usted quiere.
sentences.english: On Thursday, if you want.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: El jueves está bien.
sentences.english: Thursday is fine.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Voy a traer mi bolsa.
sentences.english: I am going to bring my bag.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: ¿Adónde vas ahora, Miguel?
sentences.english: Where are you going now, Miguel?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Voy hacia la terminal por mis cosas.
sentences.english: I am going toward the terminal for my things.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: ¿Cuánto pesa la bolsa?
sentences.english: How much does the bag weigh?

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Si pesa mucho, Sam lo ayuda.
sentences.english: If it weighs a lot, Sam will help.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Yo ayudo con gusto.
sentences.english: I will gladly help.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Ni el doctor ni Sam pagan el café.
sentences.english: Neither the doctor nor Sam pays for the coffee.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Es mi regalo.
sentences.english: It is my gift.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Muchas gracias, señora Carmen.
sentences.english: Thank you very much, señora Carmen.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Le agradezco todo.
sentences.english: I am grateful for everything.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Esta es su casa.
sentences.english: This is your home.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.text: Que Dios lo bendiga.
sentences.english: May God bless you.

sentences.text: Miguel y la señora Carmen se dan la mano.
sentences.english: Miguel and señora Carmen shake hands.

sentences.text: Sam está contento: hay un cuarto para Miguel, y hay una amiga más.
sentences.english: Sam is happy: there is a room for Miguel, and one more friend.
